ps -p 266816 -o pid,etime,cmd --no-headers 2>/dev/null || echo "PROCESS_DEAD"

```bash
tail -80 ~/runs/exec-sim-repair-verifier/repo-level-cwm-8b-conda-v4.log 2>/dev/null

```
